html:
A Gambian army lieutenant who seized power in a coup on 22 July 1994, overthrowing Dawda Jawara, and ruled until January 2017.

He won a series of elections that opponents called unfair, and his rule was marked by the jailing and killing of critics and journalists. He declared the Gambia an Islamic republic in 2015 and left the Commonwealth in 2013. In December 2016 he lost the election to Adama Barrow, first accepted the result, then rejected it. Troops of ECOWAS entered the country and he left for exile in Equatorial Guinea. This ended in the 2016 crisis.
